== Description ==

[[Brandon Baity]] (main subject, beard, green Terrex jacket, name tag “Brandon Baity / Killer Kiwi”) and [[Paul Coggins]] (background, brown/white plaid shirt, black cap with gold lettering, back to the camera) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025.
